start_here.title: Locate the missing stage in a back-take exchange
start_here.task: Recall one exchange where you got behind someone but did not settle on the back. Compare that moment with the entry headings in Volumes 7–8 and the control headings in Volume 1. Choose which group describes your unresolved stage; owners can begin at the entry introduction below.
